expr: (lst.find? (fun x => decide ((lst.filter (fun y => y = x)).length > lst.length / 2))).getD (-1)

lemmas.name: maj11
lemmas.statement: ∀ (lst : List Int) (h : findMajorityElement_precond lst) (res : Int), (((∀ x, x ∈ lst → (lst.filter (fun y => y = x)).length ≤ lst.length / 2) ∧ res = -1) ∨ (lst.filter (fun y => y = res)).length > lst.length / 2) → findMajorityElement_postcond lst res h
lemmas.proof:
by intro lst h res hc
  unfold findMajorityElement_postcond
  dsimp only
  rcases hc with ⟨hall, hres⟩ | hmaj
  · exact ⟨fun _ => Or.inl (List.all_eq_true.mpr fun x hx => by simpa using hall x hx), fun hne => absurd hres hne⟩
  · have hmaj' : (lst.filter (fun y => y = res)).length > lst.length / 2 ∧ lst.all (fun x => decide ((lst.filter (fun y => y = x)).length ≤ lst.length / 2 ∨ x = res)) = true := by
      refine ⟨hmaj, List.all_eq_true.mpr fun x hx => ?_⟩
      by_cases hxr : x = res
      · simp [hxr]
      · have := Refine.filter_pair_le lst x res hxr
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]; left; omega
    exact ⟨fun _ => Or.inr hmaj', fun _ => hmaj'⟩

lemmas.name: find11
lemmas.statement: ∀ (lst : List Int) (h : findMajorityElement_precond lst), findMajorityElement_postcond lst ((lst.find? (fun x => decide ((lst.filter (fun y => y = x)).length > lst.length / 2))).getD (-1)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro lst h
  apply maj11 lst h
  cases hf : lst.find? (fun x => decide ((lst.filter (fun y => y = x)).length > lst.length / 2)) with
  | none =>
    left
    refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
    intro x hx
    have := List.find?_eq_none.mp hf x hx
    simpa using this
  | some r =>
    right
    simp only [Option.getD_some]
    have hp := List.find?_some hf
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at hp
    exact hp
